title: Tavily Integration Tools
summary: This module provides a suite of tools for integrating with the Tavily API, enabling CrewAI agents to perform web searches, extract content from web pages, and manage comprehensive research tasks.

nodes.label: CrewAI Agent
nodes.title: CrewAI Agent
nodes.description: An intelligent agent within the CrewAI framework that utilizes various tools to accomplish tasks.

nodes.label: Extract Web Content
nodes.title: Tavily Extractor Tool
nodes.description: A tool that uses the Tavily API to extract structured content from specified web pages, supporting both basic and advanced extraction depths.

nodes.label: Retrieve Research Results
nodes.title: Tavily Get Research Tool
nodes.description: A tool to retrieve the status and results of an existing Tavily research task using its request ID, returning the data as JSON.

nodes.label: Create Tavily Research Task
nodes.title: Tavily Research Tool
nodes.description: A tool for creating new research tasks via the Tavily Research API, allowing specification of model, output schema, streaming, and citation format.

nodes.label: Perform Web Search
nodes.title: Tavily Search Tool
nodes.description: A tool that performs web searches using the Tavily Search API, offering options for search depth, topic, time range, and result filtering.

nodes.label: Tavily API
nodes.title: Tavily API Service
nodes.description: The external Tavily API service providing web search, content extraction, and research capabilities.

groups.label: User Interface / Agent
groups.title: Agent Interaction Layer
groups.description: Represents the CrewAI agent interacting with the Tavily tools.

groups.label: Tavily Analytical Tools
groups.title: Tavily Data Analysis & Retrieval
groups.description: Tools focused on retrieving and analyzing information from the web using Tavily's capabilities.

groups.label: Tavily Research Generation
groups.title: Tavily Research Task Creation
groups.description: Tool for initiating and managing comprehensive research tasks through the Tavily API.

groups.label: External Tavily Service
groups.title: Tavily API Backend
groups.description: The external Tavily API that provides the core search, extraction, and research functionalities.
